exposure: Subanesthetic dose of intravenous ketamine (0.2 mg/kg)
outcome: Total doses of analgesia in 24 hours
Time of first rescue analgesic agent given
cohort: 60 women aged 18-35 years undergoing cesarean delivery.
finding: Subanesthetic doses of intravenous ketamine after cesarean delivery enhanced postoperative analgesia, prolonged time to first rescue analgesic request, and led to high patient satisfaction, although with a higher incidence of nausea and vomiting.
